images.caption: Instead of being surrounded by large glass panels on all sides (except the feet) with large sharks, stingrays and other creatures swimming all round, all you have now is some walls simulated to resemble rock, interspersed with narrow strips of glass in between, and of course the roof glass still exposed. Some of the windows are circular, giving a distorted view of the marine animals. This has robbed viewers of over 50% of the fun of the large aquarium in the Ocean Park. Now look at this large shark on your head: isn't this a rather lousy perspective? Jan/ Feb. 2012.
